text:
zoe: Morning - I finished the recurrence synthesis for the last 6 months of postmortems. Focal themes: 1) KV cold cascades during chained model swaps, 2) premature scale-downs after burst windows (autoscaler policy), 3) transient inter-region packet drops causing brief RPC retries. Posting counts, owner proposals, and a phased remediation roadmap.

harry: Can you share the raw counts and the extraction query?

zoe: Window: 2025-09-15..2026-03-15. Counts: kv_cascade=16, autoscale_premature=12, region_transient=8. Extraction (sanitized):```sql
SELECT root_cause, COUNT(1) cnt
FROM incidents
WHERE created_at >= '2025-09-15' AND created_at <= '2026-03-15'
AND tags @> ARRAY['postmortem']
GROUP BY root_cause
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```

ana: kv_cascade - any cluster or model skew? or mostly session-driven?

zoe: Mix. ~65% tied to multi-model sessions (rapid swaps) on Dedicated pools, some on Private where customers do A/B switching. Also a few cases coincide with model weight rollouts.

infra-bot: infra-bot created ticket INF-5360 "KV cascade mitigation + per-model cold counters"

mike: Proposed ownerships: mike -> KV counters + adaptive warmup (owner + 3-week mitigation plan), harry -> autoscaler policy (RFC + tight canary, 2 weeks), ana -> inter-region retry heuristics + observability (10 business days). sgt-ops? Who owns customer comms for Dedicated impact?

sara: I can coordinate customer comms with CS for Dedicated. Will draft templates and approval flow.

harry: I'll take autoscaler. Plan: add a short-term smoothing window (45s) and a cap on scale-down velocity (max 25% per minute). I'll include a small safeguard to prevent scale-down during model-swap windows detected by swap.events. Draft RFC in 5 working days, canary in 7. Need perf-harness and historical traffic replay.

mike: For KV counters: will add metric metrics.kv.cold.start.v1 sharded by model_version+deployment and a kv.swap_heartbeat. Also PoC an adaptive warmup path that runs a lightweight prefix replay that populates KV for a set of high-signal models. PoC 12 days, mitigation 21 days.

ana: On the adaptive warmup, watch out for added load to Dedicated pools. Recommend a capped, prioritized warmup queue and an optional warmup budget per deployment. We should add that to the design.

mike: Good call - will add budget gating to INF-5360.

infra-bot: infra-bot linked INF-5360, INF-5361, INF-5362 to epic INF-5369 "recurrence-remediation-2026-q1"

ana: For inter-region retries: I'll add jittered backoff and per-route circuit-breakers, plus a short-lived sticky routing option to avoid immediately failing over to another region on transient packet loss. Target: initial change in 8 business days, full roll in 3 weeks. I'll also add two new observability signals: route.retry_rate and swap-tail95-latency.

sara: Customer comms plan: I'll prepare an evergreen note for Dedicated customers explaining the mitigations and expected timeline. Draft in 4 business days; will route to legal if wording touches SLAs.

harry: Quicksprint ask: can we instrument a model-swap smoke test in CI that runs nightly against a small Dedicated staging pool? If it fails we automatically block model-weight promos to Dedicated for 24h.

mike: We can - will add a smoke job that does a short swap and asserts kv.hit_ratio > 0.5 within 45s and tail latency < 1s. We'll run it in the staging pool and gate promos. Adding subtask to INF-5360.

zoe: Action summary (owners + targets):
- INF-5360 mike: KV counters + adaptive warmup + smoke job (PoC 12d, mitigation 21d)
- INF-5361 harry: Autoscaler policy RFC + canary (RFC 5d, canary 7bd)
- INF-5362 ana: Inter-region retry heuristics + obs (8bd initial, 3w full)
- INF-5369 sara: Epic owner for communications + runbook updates (draft comms 4bd, runbook 10bd)

zoe: I'll run a checkpoint here in 14 days and include a one-pager in the next incident retro. Goal metric: reduce recurrence count by >=50% over a 30-day window post-mitigation.

infra-bot: reminder-bot scheduled follow-up in #incidents in 14 days for thread 2140000000

mike: small note: to avoid metric cardinality issues, we'll set per-model counters to TTL 90d and only track top-K models by recent-swap-volume. I'll add details in INF-5360.

ana: Also recommend we tag future postmortems with recurrence:kv_swap, recurrence:autoscaler, recurrence:region_transient so rollups are easier.

zoe: Good idea - I'll add tagging guidelines to the incident playbook and make tagging mandatory on postmortem close for the next quarter.

sara: Thanks all. Please update tickets with PR links and test artifacts. Ping here for blockers. Closing until checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
